spec.name: grain-1024-v3
spec.comment: ADR 0066 grain sweep at N = 8: filter rows per task 1 to 128, local histogram KB per task 1 to 128, powers of two, plus Rayon's adaptive split (no grain). passes = (8192 / 1024)^2 = 64 as in the cutoff campaign (ADR 0064). The atomic histogram is left out here: this size needs 64 passes per sample and its counters accumulate across passes. Run again on measured/v3 (ADR 0084).
